question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should inline autogrow plus the configurable send shortcut remain the intended long-prompt path?
rationale: The issue is useful and current main does not implement it, but adding a second composer mode is a UX/product choice rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Build the modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard coverage.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer
options.body: Declare the current autogrow textarea plus modifier-send setting as the intended solution and close or narrow this request.

options.title: Defer Mode Choice
options.body: Keep the issue open but out of repair automation until a Control UI owner chooses the editor shape.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
recommendation.body: Build the modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest adjacent shortcut ownership and prior review context for this issue.
